steps: Your email wasn't found in this leak, but if you had an Adobe account back then, change that password to be safe.
Turn on two-step verification (2FA) for Adobe.
Use a password manager so every site gets its own unique password.
Expect phishing emails that mention Adobe; sign in by typing the address, not by clicking links.
Change your MyFitnessPal password, and the password on any other site where you reused it.
Turn on two-step verification (2FA) for MyFitnessPal.
Use a password manager so every site gets its own unique password.
Expect phishing emails that mention MyFitnessPal; sign in by typing the address, not by clicking links.
